form.label: AWS Cloud Audit and Security SOC
form.description: CloudTrail/GuardDuty/VPC Flow hunts for exposed-credential cloud intrusion patterns: fixture-backed STS discovery, IAM privilege escalation, Lambda/EC2 staging, S3 object access/deletion/ransom-note writes, and suspicious source/user-agent context. Review results before treating them as malicious.

search.query: $index_filter$ (sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail OR sourcetype=aws:cloud:guardduty OR sourcetype=aws:cloud:vpcflow) (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval family=coalesce(aws_family, case(sourcetype="aws:cloud:cloudtrail","cloudtrail", sourcetype="aws:cloud:guardduty","guardduty", sourcetype="aws:cloud:vpcflow","vpc_flow")) | timechart span=1h count by family limit=10

$index_filter$ sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval hunt_stage=case(eventName IN ("GetCallerIdentity","ListUsers","ListBuckets","GetSendQuota","ListVerifiedEmailAddresses","GetAccountSendingEnabled","GetAccount","ListIdentities"),"01 discovery", eventName IN ("CreateRole","AttachRolePolicy"),"02 IAM privilege escalation", eventName IN ("CreateSecurityGroup","AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress","CreateKeyPair","RunInstances"),"03 EC2 staging", eventName IN ("CreateFunction20150331","CreateFunction","CreateLogGroup","CreateLogStream"),"04 Lambda staging", eventName IN ("GetObject","DeleteObject","PutObject"),"05 S3 object access/delete/write") | where isnotnull(hunt_stage) | timechart span=1h count by hunt_stage limit=10

$index_filter$ sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail eventName IN ("GetCallerIdentity","ListUsers","ListBuckets","GetSendQuota","ListVerifiedEmailAddresses","GetAccountSendingEnabled","GetAccount","ListIdentities") (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval actor=coalesce('userIdentity.arn', src_user, user, 'userIdentity.userName') | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(eventSource) as event_sources values(eventName) as event_names values(src_ip) as src_ips values(userAgent) as user_agents by aws_account_id actor | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

panel.title: IAM privilege escalation: role creation and policy attach

search.query: $index_filter$ sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com eventName IN ("CreateRole","AttachRolePolicy") (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval actor=coalesce('userIdentity.arn', src_user, user, 'userIdentity.userName') | eval role_name=coalesce('requestParameters.roleName', 'requestParameters.roleArn') | eval policy_arn='requestParameters.policyArn' | eval admin_policy=if(match(policy_arn,"AdministratorAccess"),"yes","no") | table _time aws_account_id aws_region actor src_ip userAgent eventName role_name policy_arn admin_policy errorCode marker | sort - _time

$index_filter$ sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail eventName IN ("CreateSecurityGroup","AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress","CreateKeyPair","RunInstances","CreateFunction20150331","CreateFunction","CreateLogGroup","CreateLogStream") (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval actor=coalesce('userIdentity.arn', src_user, user, 'userIdentity.userName') | eval function_or_group=coalesce('requestParameters.functionName', 'requestParameters.logGroupName', 'requestParameters.groupName', 'requestParameters.keyName') | eval instance_type='requestParameters.instanceType' | table _time aws_account_id aws_region actor src_ip userAgent eventName eventSource function_or_group instance_type errorCode marker | sort - _time

panel.title: S3 object access, deletion, and ransom-note style writes

search.query: $index_filter$ sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail eventSource=s3.amazonaws.com eventName IN ("GetObject","DeleteObject","PutObject") (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval actor=coalesce('userIdentity.arn', src_user, user, 'userIdentity.userName') | eval bucket=coalesce('requestParameters.bucketName', mvindex(resources{}.ARN,0)) | eval object_key='requestParameters.key' | eval possible_ransom_note=if(eventName="PutObject" AND match(lower(coalesce(object_key,"")),"(ransom|readme|urgent|recover|decrypt)"),"review","") | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen values(eventName) as actions values(object_key) as sample_keys values(src_ip) as src_ips values(userAgent) as user_agents values(possible_ransom_note) as ransom_note_flag by aws_account_id actor bucket | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

panel.title: Source IP and user-agent pivots for CloudTrail hunts

search.query: $index_filter$ sourcetype=aws:cloud:cloudtrail (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR recipientAccountId=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval actor=coalesce('userIdentity.arn', src_user, user, 'userIdentity.userName') | stats count dc(eventName) as distinct_api values(eventName) as event_names values(userAgent) as user_agents values(aws_region) as regions values(actor) as actors by aws_account_id src_ip | where count>=3 OR distinct_api>=3 | sort - distinct_api - count

panel.title: GuardDuty findings and VPC flow context for the same window

search.query: $index_filter$ (sourcetype=aws:cloud:guardduty OR sourcetype=aws:cloud:vpcflow) (aws_account_id=$account_filter$ OR accountId=$account_filter$) | eval signal=coalesce(signature, type, action, "vpc_flow") | eval endpoint=coalesce(src_ip, dest_ip) | stats count values(severity) as severity values(signal) as signals values(src_ip) as src_ips values(dest_ip) as dest_ips values(action) as actions values(log_status) as log_status by aws_account_id sourcetype endpoint | sort - count
